summary: Iter150 Phase 2.5 · Phase A tested end-to-end. 12/12 backend pytest tests pass: tasks/notifications smoke endpoints, CA auto-emit (task created with source_module='safety.corrective_actions', priority echoed, plus task.assigned notification + unread-count incremented), role scoping (HR cannot see safety-assigned tasks; Admin sees all), auth gate (401 without portal token). Frontend Playwright verified: /tasks renders with tasks-page + 4 summary tiles + tasks-tab-open + tasks-priority-filter + 11 task rows including auto-emitted CA tasks (HIGH priority badge correctly echoed). Task drawer opens on row click with status switcher (Open/In Progress/Pending Review/Completed/Closed/Cancelled), comments composer, audit history. Notification bell shows badge='3' in Safety header. /access-denied renders with data-testid='access-denied-page'. SafetyHub has safety-tile-tasks. Login + nav successful.

ui_bugs.issue: Could not detect [data-testid=notification-drawer] or [data-testid=notification-mark-all-read] when clicking the bell. Bell + badge render correctly, but the open drawer / mark-all-read button either don't carry those exact testids or are inside a portal with a different attribute scope. Worth verifying naming in NotificationBell.jsx (may need to add testids to drawer body and the Mark all read action).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle (a11y console warning) — wrap title in VisuallyHidden or add DialogTitle

action_items: Verify NotificationBell.jsx renders the open container with data-testid='notification-drawer' and the bulk action button with data-testid='notification-mark-all-read'. Currently the bell + badge work but those two testids were not detectable from Playwright; main agent should self-test by opening the drawer and inspecting the DOM. (Functional behavior was likely fine — only testid discoverability is in question.)
Optional: add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) inside the task drawer and notification drawer Dialog components to clear the Radix accessibility console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: tasks_notifications.py scope filter is correct (HR sees role='hr' OR null only; Admin bypass via {}). Verified empirically.
Auto-emit in corrective_actions.py is properly wrapped in try/except and is fire-and-forget so it cannot break CA creation — good defensive pattern for the foundation layer.
Notification TTL via expires_at=now+60d + Mongo TTL index is solid; tasks TTL on closed_at=365d is correct.

/api/notifications/unread-count iterates documents in Python instead of using a Mongo aggregation pipeline; not a bug now but at >1k notifications per role this will become a hot path. Consider switching to db.notifications.count_documents({...}) with a $elemMatch read_by filter when collection grows.
_scope_filter has redundant clause: {assignee_role: role} and {assignee_role: {$in: [role, None]}} — the latter subsumes the former. Cosmetic only.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all critical testids verified except notification-drawer/notification-mark-all-read which need DOM-level confirmation)

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_iter150 prefixed tasks + CAs during testing. They live in db.tasks and db.corrective_actions with TEST_ prefix — safe to leave for next iteration or bulk-delete via {title: /^TEST_iter150/}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend infrastructure for Phase A (tasks + notifications) is verified solid and ready to be consumed by Phase B (Document Expirations), Phase C (Employee Lifecycle), Phase D (PO Requests). The two services to reuse: task_service.create() and notification_service.fanout() from routes/tasks_notifications.py. ALLOWED_SOURCE_MODULES already lists future module slugs. Conftest.py auto-attaches X-Admin-Token via monkeypatch — for role-scoping tests you MUST pass headers={'X-Admin-Token': ''} to force the portal token to take effect.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found this iteration. Two NotificationBell testids could not be confirmed from the automation harness; this is likely a testid-naming concern rather than a functional defect (bell+badge themselves work and the badge value 3 is consistent with backend unread-count).
